Walked and finally after taking a right turn and then walked 1 km. After walking he reached point 'K'. In which direction was he walking when he reached there?

items.rule: Four right turns from East (south, west, north, east) leave him walking east.
items.note: "He then right me" is read as a right turn. If it is not a turn, the last right turn leaves him facing north (D). Check against the book key.

payload.stem: Hrithik from his office goes straight towards East and after traveling 4 km takes a right turn. From here he covered a distance of 3 km and again took a right turn. After covering a distance of 4 km he finally takes a left turn and travels straight. In which direction was Hrithik heading in the end?

items.rule: East, then right (south), right (west), left (south): he heads south.

payload.stem: Ram walks 4 km towards north from his university campus and then he takes a left turn to reach his department. After walking 2.5 km to his department, he takes a left turn and walks 4 km to reach the conference room. In which direction is he now from his starting point?

items.rule: North 4, west 2.5, south 4: he ends 2.5 km due west of the start.

payload.stem: Starting from Anand's house, the bus moves 3 km towards the right. After that it takes a left turn and travels a distance of 2 km. Finally it takes a right turn and covers a distance of 4 km. When the bus reached the school, it was facing south-east, then which direction was the bus facing when it dropped Anand home?

items.rule: A left turn and then a right turn cancel, so the bus faces at the end the way it faced at the start: south-east.
items.note: Read as the direction the bus faced when it set off from Anand's house. "When it dropped Anand home" is ambiguous; check against the book key.

payload.stem: Town C is to the south of Town A. Town D is to the west of town A. Town B is to the east of town D. Town E is to the south of town B and South-east of Town C. What is the position of town A with respect to town B ?

items.rule: E is south of B and south-east of C, and C is due south of A, so B is east of A. A is therefore west of B.

payload.stem: A lies to the north-west of C and north of D. If B is to the east of A, what is the position of D with repect to B ?

items.rule: D is due south of A and B due east of A, so D lies south and west of B: South-West.

payload.stem: Town B is to the east of Town A. Town C is to the north of Town B. Town D is to the east of Town C. Town E is to the south of Town D. What is the position of Town E with respect to Town A ? (All positions are arranged in GRID pattern)

items.rule: On a grid: B is 1 east of A, C 1 north of B, D 1 east of C, E 1 south of D. E is 2 east of A, due east.

payload.stem: After leaving the school, Hemant and Anurag walk 1 km towards North to reach the bus stop. From the bus stop, Hemant takes a left turn and walks 500 m. Then he turns to his left and walks 2 km to reach his home. From the bus stop, Anurag takes a right turn and walks 250 m. Then he takes a right turn and walks 1 km to reach his home. In which direction is Anurag's house from Hemant's house?

items.rule: From the bus stop, Hemant goes west 0.5 and south 2; Anurag goes east 0.25 and south 1. Anurag's house is 0.75 km east and 1 km north of Hemant's.

payload.stem: Tamanna is walking towards north from her house. After walking 500 metres, she took a left turn and walked 500 metres. Then she took a left turn and walked 250 meters and reached her friend's house. In which direction is his house from her friend's house ?

items.rule: North 500, west 500, south 250: her house is 500 m east and 250 m south of the friend's house.

payload.stem: B is west of E. A is north-west of B. F is north-east of B. D is south-east of F, such that F is north-west of E and D is south-east of E as well. If C is south-west of E, what is the position of A with respect to E? (All positions are arranged in GRID pattern)

items.rule: On a grid with E at the centre: B is 2 west, F 1 west and 1 north, A 1 west and 1 north of B. A is 3 west and 1 north of E.

payload.stem: On his way to school, Mohan travels 2 km straight from his home, then takes a left turn and travels 4 km. From here he turns right. And after covering a distance of 2 km he again takes a right turn and travels 2 km to finally reach the school. If he was finally traveling towards west, in which direction is his home from the school?

items.rule: Left, right, right is a net right turn, and he ends heading west, so he set off south. South 2, east 4, south 2, west 2: home is 2 km west and 4 km north of the school.

payload.stem: Tina is 75m to the south-east of Veena. Reena is 75m south-west of Veena. Tina is in Rina's .......

items.rule: Tina and Reena are the same distance south of Veena, Tina to the east and Reena to the west. Tina is east of Reena ("Rina" in the print).

payload.stem: Prince drives 8 km towards east from point A. He takes a right turn and drives 3 km. Again, he takes a right turn and drives 5 km. He takes a right turn and drives 8 km. Finally, he takes a left turn and drives 3 km to reach point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive now in order to reach point A again?

items.rule: East 8, south 3, west 5, north 8, west 3: B is 5 km due north of A, so he drives 5 km south.

payload.stem: A person starts from point X and moves 7 km towards the south. He then turns left and moves 5 km. He then takes a right turn and moves 5 km. He then turns right and moves 5 km to reach point Y. How much and in which direction does he need to move now to reach point X ?

items.rule: South 7, east 5, south 5, west 5: Y is 12 km due south of X, so 12 km north.

payload.stem: Starting from point A, an animal walks 15 m towards East. Now he turned left and walked 25 m. Now he took a right turn and walked 10 m. Then took a left turn and walked 15 m. Finally, he took a left turn and walked 25 m. How far and in which direction is the animal now from its starting point A?

items.rule: East 15, north 25, east 10, north 15, west 25: 40 m due north of A.

payload.stem: Zoya came out of the bank and walked 14 m to north. After that she turned to her left and walked 20 m. After that she again took a left turn and walked 36 m. Now she again turns to her left and walks 65 m. In which direction will she have to turn and what distance will she have to cover to reach the hospital which is 45m in the east direction from the bank?

items.rule: North 14, west 20, south 36, east 65: she stands 45 m east of the bank, 22 m south of the hospital, facing east. North is to her left: 22 m.

payload.stem: Starting from point Z, Khanna walks 80 m towards South. He turned left and walked 40 m. After that, he took a right turn and walked 40 m. After that he takes a left turn and walks 20 m. Again he turned to his left and walked 120 m. walked. How far and in which direction is Khanna now from the starting point Z?

items.rule: South 80, east 40, south 40, east 20, north 120: 60 m due east of Z.

payload.stem: Two football players A and B of the opposing team start playing from the same corner. A 35 m towards east and then runs 15 towards south, he takes right turn and runs 60 m. Meanwhile B runs 20 m towards north and then 25 m towards west, turns to his left and runs 20 m. What is the position of B with respect of A ?

items.rule: A: east 35, south 15, west 60, ending 25 m west and 15 m south of the corner. B: north 20, west 25, south 20, ending 25 m west on the corner line. B is 15 m due north of A.

payload.stem: Two workers X and Y start walking from the same place. X walks 65 m west, then turns left and walks 25 m. In the meanwhile Y walks 20 m North, then turns to his right and walks 35 m, then turns south and walks 45 m. Where is Y with respect to X ?

items.rule: X ends 65 m west and 25 m south; Y ends 35 m east and 25 m south. Y is 100 m due east of X.

payload.stem: After their day's work two village women are returning home. The first woman walks 1.5 km west, then turns to her right and 3 km to reach her house. In the mean while the second woman walks 1 km North, then she turns east and walks 3.5 km, then she turns to her left and walks 2 km to reach her house. Where is the first woman's house with respect to second woman's house ?

items.rule: The first house is 1.5 km west and 3 km north; the second is 3.5 km east and 3 km north. The first is 5 km due west of the second.

payload.stem: Two navy ships start from the same port. Ship A travels 23 km west, then turns to its left and travels 19 km. Ship B travels 19 km west, then turns north and travels 5 km, then turns to its left and travels 4 km. Where is ship A with respect to ship B ?

items.rule: A ends 23 km west and 19 km south; B ends 23 km west and 5 km north. A is 24 km due south of B.

payload.stem: Suman drives 3 km towards north from point A. She takes a right turn and drives 4 km more. Then she takes another right turn and drives 3 km. Finally, she takes one more right turn and drives 6 km to reach point B. How far and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach point A again?

items.rule: North 3, east 4, south 3, west 6: B is 2 km due west of A, so she drives 2 km east.

payload.stem: Vimla starts from her house and walks 30m towards North and then takes a right turn and walks 40m. Then she takes a left turn and walks 35 meters. After that, she takes a right turn and walks 40 meters. From there she takes a right turn and walks 85 meters. Then she again takes a right turn and walks 50 meters. From there it finally turns right. and walks 20 meters. How far is he from his home now and in which direction is he with respect to his home?

items.rule: North 30, east 40, north 35, east 40, south 85, west 50, north 20: 30 m due east of home.

payload.stem: On a certain day John decided to go to school using his newly purchased skates. So, he left his house and skated 15 km northwards, then turned left and skated 7 km, then he took another left turn and skated 15 km, and then finally turned right and skated 13 km. How far exactly is his school from his house ?

items.rule: North 15, west 7, south 15, west 13: the school is 20 km due west of the house.

payload.stem: In the evening, Amit and Ashwini are sitting in a park in such a way that their backs are facing each other. If Amit's shadow falls to the right of Ashwini, then which direction is Amit facing?

items.rule: In the evening the sun is in the west, so shadows fall east. Amit's shadow falls to Ashwini's right, so her right is east and she faces north. Back to back, Amit faces south.

payload.stem: While coming home from school at 5 pm, Ketki's shadow was falling on his left side. In which direction is the school from his house?

items.rule: At 5 pm the sun is in the west, so the shadow falls east. East is on the left only when facing south, so Ketki walks south to reach home: the school is to the north.

payload.stem: Mridul, 145 m towards East. Cycles and then takes a left turn and walks 155 m. rides a bicycle. Again, he takes a left turn and walks 225 m. rides a bicycle. He finally takes a left turn and walks 95 m to reach his house. rides a bicycle. Find the shortest distance between his house and starting point.

items.rule: East 145, north 155, west 225, south 95: the house is 80 m west and 60 m north of the start, √(80² + 60²) = 100 m.

payload.stem: Meenal is 45 m towards north. walks and then she takes a left turn and walks 35 m. It moves From there, she takes a right turn and walks 26 m. walks and then again takes a right turn and walks 35 m. It moves Finally she takes a left turn and walks 17m to reach her home. It moves How far is he from the starting point?

items.rule: North 45, west 35, north 26, east 35, north 17: home is 88 m due north of the start.

payload.stem: Rohini walks 10 Km. towards North and turns to the right and walks 10 kms. and then turns to the left and walks 10 kms. and walks and then turns to the right and walks 10 km. How far (in km) is he from his starting point?

items.rule: North 10, east 10, north 10, east 10: 20 km east and 20 km north, √800 = 20√2 km.

payload.stem: P is 15 km towards East. He takes a right turn and walks 10 km. He takes a right turn and walks 15 km. At what distance (in km) is he from his starting point?

items.rule: East 15, south 10, west 15: 10 km due south of the start.

payload.stem: Kedar left his house and cycled 25 km towards South and reached the bus stand. Then he took a left turn and went 15 km, again he took a left turn and went 25 km. How far is he from his original place?

items.rule: South 25, east 15, north 25: 15 km due east of home.

payload.stem: Rahman went from his office to the district headquarters. He started his journey towards the west. First he went straight for 20 km, then he turned to his left and walked 9 km, finally, he took a right turn and walked 20 km to reach the district headquarter. What is the shortest distance between Rahman's office and the district headquarter?

items.rule: West 20, south 9, west 20: 40 km west and 9 km south, √(40² + 9²) = 41 km.

payload.stem: Maheep started from his office and walked 120m towards South. Then he took a left turn and walked a certain distance of A m. Then he took a right turn and walked 80 m. Then he took a left turn and covered a distance of B m. After covering this distance, he reached his home. If the shortest distance between Maheep's office and home is 290m, then what is the sum of the distances A and B covered by him?

items.rule: He goes 120 + 80 = 200 m south and A + B east. √((A + B)² + 200²) = 290, so A + B = 210 m.

payload.stem: Pritam started from point B and walked 40m towards west. Then he left me and walked 35m. Then he took a right turn and walked 25m. Harmeet started from point A and walked 45m towards East. Then he took a right turn and walked 35m to meet Pritam. What is the distance between point A and point B?

items.rule: From B, Pritam ends 65 m west and 35 m south ("he left me" read as a left turn). From A, Harmeet ends 45 m east and 35 m south at the same spot. So A is 110 m west of B.

payload.stem: Navya starts from her house and walks 27 m. to the west. From there, she takes a right turn and covers a certain distance Pm. Then she turns to her right and walks 16 m. Then she again takes a right turn and walks 72 m. After that, she takes a left turn and walks 11 m. If the present position of Navya is 11 m from her house. then what is the value of P?

items.rule: West 27, north P, east 16, south 72, east 11 ends due north or south of the house, |P − 72| away. That is 11 m, so P is 83 or 61; only 83 is offered.

payload.stem: Manjeet cycles X km towards North and then takes a left turn and cycles Y km to reach her shop. The minimum distance between the starting point and his shop is 5 km. What can be the X and Y values in km respectively?

items.rule: North X then west Y is a right angle, so X² + Y² = 5² = 25. Only 3 and 4 give it.

payload.stem: Suyash starts walking from point A and walks 130 m towards South-East. Pradeep starts walking from point B and walks 130 m towards South-West. After covering these distances, they both meet at point C. Point D is located such that if points A and B are joined to each other by a straight line, then point D will be the midpoint of that line. If the distance between points C and D is 120 m, then find the distance between points A and B.

items.rule: AC = BC = 130 m and D is the midpoint of AB, so CD is perpendicular to AB: AD = √(130² − 120²) = 50, and AB = 100 m.
items.note: Exact South-East and South-West headings would put C √2 × 65 ≈ 92 m from D, not 120 m; the question means the triangle, not the compass. Check against the book key.

payload.stem: Samitra walks 4 km towards north, turn right and walks 5 km. Turning South and 2 kms. Then he turns towards west and walks 3 km. Goes and stays for a while. then walks 2 km. How far is Samitra from the starting point ?

items.rule: North 4, east 5, south 2, west 3 leaves her 2 km east and 2 km north; 2 km more to the west ends 2 km due north of the start.
items.note: "Then walks 2 km" gives no direction; read as continuing west. Check against the book key.

payload.stem: Starting from point O, Mahesh walks 5 km. towards south, then turns to his right and walks 3 km. From there he again turns right and walks 5 km. Then he turns to his left and walks 5 km. How far is he from his starting point?

items.rule: South 5, west 3, north 5, west 5: 8 km due west of O.

payload.stem: Ankit walks 17 km towards east. He turns left and walks 17 km. He turns left again and walks 24 km to reach point A. What is the straight line distance (in km) between the starting point and point A ?

items.rule: East 17, north 17, west 24: 7 km west and 17 km north, √338 = 13√2 km.

items.rule: North 15, west 7, south 15, west 13: the school is 20 km due west of the house. (Q30 again.)

payload.stem: Anita starts from her house and cycles 6 km towards the south and then turns left and cycles 8 km. She again turns left and cycles for X km to reach her school. Point A is to the west of her school and also 3 km to the north of her house. What is the value of X?

items.rule: South 6 and east 8 put her 6 km below the house line; the school is level with A, 3 km north of the house. X = 6 + 3 = 9 km.

payload.stem: Bismita walks 200 meters towards East and then takes a right turn and walks 210 meters to reach the hospital. What is the shortest distance between the starting point and the hospital?

Arjun starts walking in the east direction. After walking 50 meters, he turns to his left and walks 15 meters straight. Then from there he turns to his left and walks 30 meters straight. He again turns to his left and walks 15 meters. How far is he from the starting point?

items.rule: East 50, north 15, west 30, south 15: 20 m due east of the start.

payload.stem: Abhijeet leaves his house and walks 30m in the North-West direction. After that he walks 30m in South-West direction. After that he walks 30 m in the South-East direction. After that he walks 30 m in the North-East direction. How far is he from his home?

items.rule: Four equal sides, each turning 90°, close a square: back home, 0 m.

payload.stem: Rinky leaves her house and walks 70 meters towards East and then takes a right turn and walks 50 meters to reach the post office. From there again she takes a right turn and walks 150 meters to reach the market. From here she takes a left turn and walks a few meters to reach the school. If the total distance from Rinky's house to the school is 170 m, then what is the total distance between the market and the school?

items.rule: The market is 80 m west and 50 m south of the house; the school is further south of it. 80² + (50 + d)² = 170², so 50 + d = 150 and d = 100 m.

payload.stem: Indu starts travelling towards East and after walking 35 km takes a right turn and walks 15 km and then takes a right turn and walks 15 km and stops. What is the minimum distance she has to travel to reach the point from where he started his journey?

items.rule: East 35, south 15, west 15: 20 km east and 15 km south, √(20² + 15²) = 25 km.

payload.stem: Two friends Ram and Shyam are standing at a point facing north. Shyam walks 5 km to his left and then turns to his left again and walks 10 km, while Ram walks 2 km to the north and then turns to his right and walks 5 km. What is the shortest distance between Ram and Shyam?

items.rule: Shyam ends 5 km west and 10 km south; Ram 5 km east and 2 km north. They are 10 km and 12 km apart on the two axes: √(100 + 144) = √244.

payload.stem: Point P is 80 metres to the north of point Q. Point R is 100 metres to the east of point Q. Point S is 120 metres to the north of point R. Point S is 120 metres to the east of point T. Point V is 60 metres to the South of point T. How far and in which direction is point P from point V ?

items.rule: With Q at the origin: P (0, 80), V (−20, 60). P is 20 m east and 20 m north of V: 20√2 metres, North-East.

payload.stem:
Prakash walks 50 metre towards the East. He turns to the left and walks 30 metre. He turns to the right and walks 40 metre. He turns to the left at an angle of 135 degree and walks 20 metre. He turns to the left and walks 10 metre. Finally, he turns to the right at an angle of 45 degree and walks 50 metre. Which of the following statement is correct ?

payload.stem:
From point P, a boy walks 10 metre towards the North and reaches point Q. He turns to the right and walks 14 metre and reaches point R. He turns to the left and walks 20 metre and reaches point S. He turns to the right and walks 12 metre and reaches point T. Finally, he turns to the right and walks 25 metre and reaches point U. Which of the following statement is correct ?
I. The straight line distance between point R and point U is 13 metre.
II. Point P is to the North-East of the point U.

items.rule: R is (14, 10) and U is (26, 5): 12 east and 5 south, so RU = 13 m. P (0, 0) is south-west of U, not north-east.

payload.stem:
Raman walks 25 metre towards the South. He turns to the left and walks 40 metre. He turns to the left and walks 60 metre. He turns to the right and walks 20 metre. items.rule: South, +90° west, +180° east, −180° west, −45° south-west.

payload.stem: R is 16 km towards the south of T. P is 4 km towards the north of R. K is 9 km towards the west of P. G is 7 km towards the north of K. L is 21 km towards the east of G. How far T from L and in which direction of P from L ?

items.rule: With T at the origin: P (0, −12), L (12, −5). T is 12 west and 5 north of L, √(144 + 25) = 13 km; P is 12 west and 7 south of L: South-west.

payload.stem: Point L is 10 km south of point R. Point G is 12 km west of point L. Point M is 13 km south of point G. Point T is 4 km to the east of point M. How far is point T from point G?

items.rule: T is 13 km south and 4 km east of G: √(169 + 16) = √185 km.

payload.stem: Rajesh is going in the north direction. After walking 10 m, he takes a right turn and walks 40 m to reach shop L, now he takes a left turn and walks 24 m. He again takes a left turn and walks 12 m to reach hospital P. Now finally he turns back 22 m. How far and in which direction is shop L from the end point ?

items.rule: Shop L is 40 m east and 10 m north of the start. He goes on north 24, west 12, then back east 22, ending (50, 34). L is 10 m west and 24 m south of him: 26 m South-West.
items.note: The photo cuts the digit after "turns back 2"; read as 22. Check against the book key.

payload.stem: A person is facing in East direction. He turns 135° in clockwise direction. He turns 90° in anticlock wise direction. He turns 270° in clockwise direction. He turns 45° in clockwise direction. He turns 135° in clockwise direction. Finally he turns 180° in anti-clockwise direction. In which direction he is facing now ?
A is 15 km west from B. C is 10 km east from K. B is 20 km north from K. H is 5 km south from C. N is 27 km south from A. How far is K from A and in which direction is H from B?

items.rule: With K at the origin: B (0, 20), A (−15, 20), C (10, 0), H (10, −5). K is √(15² + 20²) = 25 km from A; H is 10 east and 25 south of B: south-east.

payload.stem: Sohan is facing towards north. He rotates by 145 degrees in clockwise direction. He again rotates by 290 degrees in anticlockwise direction. He again rotates by 345 degrees in anticlockwise direction. He finally rotates by 400 degrees in clockwise direction. In which direction is he facing now?
A river flows north to south and on the way turns left and goes in a quarter-circle round a hillock and then turn right at a right angle. In which direction is the river finally following?

items.rule: Flowing south, a quarter-circle to the left turns it east; a right angle to the right turns it south again.

payload.stem: Ashwin wants to book a ticket to go to Tirupati. The booking office is located in the east direction from his house, and to reach there from home he covers a distance of 8 km. From there he walks 5 km towards North and reaches Sabzi Mandi. From there he turns left and goes to his friend Swapna's house, which is located at a distance of 8 km from here. Now he has to go back to his home. How much distance will he have to cover to reach his home ?

items.rule: East 8, north 5, west 8: Swapna's house is 5 km due north of his home.

payload.stem: Aparna starts walking towards the north, after walking 30 m she turns towards the south and walks 50 m. Now she again turns east and walks 20 metres. Then she walks 20 meters towards the North. Calculate how far is she now and in which direction from the starting point?

items.rule: North 30, south 50, east 20, north 20: 20 m due east of the start.

payload.stem: My school is in the Eastern my house. Temple in North of my home and Market is South and my house. If all re not equal distance from my house in which direction the school is while respect to the Market ?

items.rule: The school is east of the house and the market south of it, whatever the distances: the school is north and east of the market.

items.rule: The school is east of the house and the post office west of it: the school is east of the post office.

payload.stem: Pratiksha leaves from her home for her college. She walks 48 m. towards West. After that, she turns towards North and walks 32 m. Then she turns right and walks 54 m. Then she goes 40 m. towards the South and reaches her college. What is the shortest distance between her home and the college?

items.rule: West 48, north 32, east 54, south 40: 6 m east and 8 m south, √(36 + 64) = 10 m.

payload.stem: Himangini started walking from her home and went 38 m towards East. Then she took a left turn and walked 57 m to reach a bank. From the bank she goes 17 m towards East. After that she took a right turn and went 17 m. She finally took a right turn and went 25 m to reach her shop. What is the shortest distance between her home and her shop?

items.rule: East 38, north 57, east 17, south 17, west 25: 30 m east and 40 m north, √(900 + 1600) = 50 m.

payload.stem: Kavya travels 30 m towards west from her home and reaches her friend Ariba's house. From there, she turns right and walks 45 m. Then she takes right turn and walks 20 m. Then she takes right turn and walks 60 m. What is the approximate shortest distance between Kavya's current position and her home?

items.rule: West 30, north 45, east 20, south 60: 10 m west and 15 m south, √325 ≈ 18 m.

items.rule: North-East (45°) becomes West (270°) and South-East (135°) becomes North (360°): every direction moves 225° clockwise. West (270°) becomes 495° = 135°: South-East.

payload.stem: In a row of students, Reeta is 11th form the right and Madhuri is 14th from the left. Riya is exactly in the middle of Reeta and Madhuri. If there are 16 students in the row, what is Riya's position from the left ?

payload.stem: In a row of swimmers, Manish is 23rd from left end and Ramesh is 11th to the left of Manish. If Ramesh is 16th from right end, then how many swimmers in this row ?
